openings.claim: Replace timestamp ordering with manifest stages in a record-linked boundary matrix. Compare matching artifact boundaries; keep equality, inequality and unknown distinct. Report the earliest recorded mismatch with an unresolved preceding interval wherever earlier divergence cannot be excluded. Missing records never prove nonexecution; distinguish observed mismatches from explanations.
openings.discriminator: Against timestamp-first mismatch ranking, skewed export time will not rank export before parse. Missing transform evidence stays unresolved. Removal widens uncertainty or leaves independently supported results unchanged, never creates a definite stage claim. Defeat conditions: ambiguous lineage, uncomparable digests, exhausted inspection capacity or intervals excluding a sheet boundary; these limit informativeness without permitting invented records.
openings.probe: Assign matrix and timestamp-first variants to disjoint three-pair subsets. Log manual inspections; stop at twelve per pair, recording residual uncertainty. Freeze outputs before opening sealed sheets. Score sheet-covered cases for boundary containment, unsupported claims and reference validity; then remove one random transform record from each of two pairs, manifests unchanged, and check downgrades. Disjoint subsets screen feasibility, not causal superiority. Use sixty analyst minutes and twenty additional minutes for scoring/removal checks; report unfinished checks.
openings.uncertainty: Dictionary and manifest must identify comparable boundaries; ambiguous matches remain unknown. Spreadsheet/script indexing within sixty minutes is assumed, not demonstrated; complete manual reconstruction is not promised. Sheet coverage beyond supplied entries is unassumed. No deployment or demonstrated improvement is established.
